deskSetReportNotSent: The report was not sent. Try again.

@deskSetReportNotSent.description: Report a problem dialog: error when sending failed.

@deskSetReportSaveDialog.description: Title of the system Save dialog when saving the report to a file.

deskSetReportSaved: Saved. Cleaned of secrets, not encrypted.

@deskSetReportSaved.description: Report a problem dialog: notice after the report was saved to a file.

deskSetReportNotSaved: The file was not saved. Try again.

@deskSetReportNotSaved.description: Report a problem dialog: error when saving to a file failed.

@deskSetReportText.description: Report a problem dialog: item in the "What is sent" list.

@deskSetReportAppLog.description: Report a problem dialog: item in the "What is sent" list. {size} is like "256 KB".

@deskSetReportSent.description: Report a problem dialog: title after the report was sent.

@deskSetReportArrived.description: Report a problem dialog: description after the report was sent, when there is no reference.

deskSetReportArrivedRef: The report arrived. Its reference is {id}.

@deskSetReportArrivedRef.description: Report a problem dialog: description after the report was sent. {id} is a reference code.

@deskSetReportDescribe.description: Report a problem dialog: error under the description field when empty.

deskSetReportDesc: Encrypted so only the developer can read it. Save to file keeps an unencrypted copy.

@deskSetReportDesc.description: Report a problem dialog: description under the title. "Send" and "Save to file" are button names.

@deskSetReportWhat.description: Report a problem dialog: label and screen reader name of the description field.

deskSetReportWhatHint: What you did, what you expected, what happened instead

@deskSetReportWhatHint.description: Report a problem dialog: placeholder of the description field.

@deskSetReportContact.description: Report a problem dialog: label and screen reader name of the optional contact field.

deskSetReportContactHint: An email address or other handle, for a reply

@deskSetReportContactHint.description: Report a problem dialog: placeholder of the contact field.

@deskSetReportAttach.description: Report a problem dialog: checkbox label.

deskSetReportAttachHint: The newest part of the app log, without the recovery phrase, password and other secrets.

@deskSetReportAttachHint.description: Report a problem dialog: small text under the Attach logs checkbox.

@deskSetReportFullDetails.description: Report a problem dialog: checkbox under Attach logs. When ticked, wallet addresses and amounts the log holds are sent as they are instead of shortened.

deskSetReportFullDetailsInfo: Sends addresses and amounts in full instead of shortened. Recovery phrases, keys and passwords are never sent.

@deskSetReportFullDetailsInfo.description: Report a problem dialog: the info popover beside the Include full details checkbox: what the tick changes (addresses and amounts the log holds go whole instead of shortened) and that seeds, keys and passwords are never in the report.

@deskSetReportPartFullDetails.description: Report a problem dialog, What is sent: the part listed when Include full details is ticked, after the app log.

@deskSetReportSentWhat.description: Report a problem dialog: title of the collapsible list of what the report holds.

@deskSetReportNotSentTitle.description: Report a problem dialog: title of the error notice when sending failed.

deskSetReportOff: Sending is off in this build

@deskSetReportOff.description: Report a problem dialog: notice shown when this app build cannot send reports.

@deskSetReportSaveToFile.description: Report a problem dialog: button that saves the report to a file.

@deskSetReportSend.description: Report a problem dialog: primary button that sends the report.

@deskSetReportFileNone.description: Report a problem › What is sent: a log file that does not go with the report. {name} is the file name.

@deskSetReportFileAll.description: Report a problem › What is sent: a log file that goes with the report whole. {size} is its size.

@deskSetReportFilePart.description: Report a problem › What is sent: only the end of a log file goes with the report. {part} is how much, {size} the whole file.
